sheets.prompt: Character turnaround model sheet for a science fiction exploration game: the same slim young man as in the reference picture, same face and messy short black curly hair, uncovered, wearing a glider pilot's flying clothes instead of his usual clothes, drawn three times full-body side by side at the same scale on a plain cream background: front view, side view, back view, standing straight, arms a little away from the body. A cropped mustard-yellow flight jacket of waxed canvas with a wide cream fleece collar lying flat on the shoulders, ribbed olive cuffs and waistband, two big patch pockets, a faded sky-blue roundel stitched on the back; olive jodhpur trousers full at the thigh and narrow below the knee, cream cloth puttees wound round the shins, short brown lace-up boots, a slim brown leather harness strap across the chest. Simple, fitted, game-ready clothing with clear colour blocks that read from above. Moebius science-fiction, Franco-Belgian ligne claire, exquisite fine pen contours, sparse delicate hatching only in shadows, luminous flat pastel gouache colours, mustard, olive and sky blue, restrained cream paper grain, clear readable construction, no lettering. Avoid: photorealism, 3d render, text, watermark, lettering, labels, hat, hood, helmet, goggles, mask, cape, scarf.
sheets.why: built in Blender (#540): long sleeves and fitted pieces that layer on his body, the clearest colour blocks from above (mustard jacket, olive jodhpurs, cream puttees, brown boots), the roundel reads from behind
